d: A humanoid demon with platinum white skin on the face and chest, featuring glowing pale yellow eyes and a sharp, mature expression. The build is lean and athletic, wearing ornate charcoal-black armor with glowing crimson accents, including a long crimson loincloth and heavy dark gauntlets. Large, obsidian-colored jagged wings sprout from the back, and a crown-like crest of horns adorns the head, with glowing red magical runes floating around the body. BODY COLOR: Platinum white and charcoal black LEGS: Digitigrade with cloven hooves.
